messages:
sam: Quick heads up - I want to pin provider + peering module for the tenant-cutover during tomorrow's quiet window. Requesting a deploybot hold for 01:00-02:30 UTC and a workspace lock.

ivy: Ack. Which versions?

sam: provider.aws=5.12.0, module.peer=v3.2.0 (avoid the new auto-route change). We'll keep module.nat unpinned for now.

rohan: Add preflight: `terraform plan -var-file=prod.pin.tfvars` and `terraform state list | grep aws_vpc_peering` to ensure no implicit deletes.

sam: Plan in playbook: select workspace prod-tenant, init, run plan with -out=canary.plan, then apply target=module.peer if plan matches. CLI snippet included in playbook.

deploybot: Hold placed by sam for tenant-cutover. Auto-merge paused. Workspace lock will be applied at runtime.

sre-bot: NOTE: Running staging smoke now; will post diff.

(00:40 UTC) sre-bot: PREVIEW: plan shows 1 change (route table entry update) and 0 replaces. Flag: check probe timeouts.

ivy: Good. What's rollback criteria?

rohan: Propose metrics: BGP flap >3 in 10m OR auth-service 5xx >5% for >5m -> immediate rollback. Also keep an escape hatch: `deploybot rollback --target=tenant-cutover --tag pre-pin` and `aws ec2 replace-route` script.

sam: Agreed. Will also add increasing probe timeout to 10s in canary.

(00:58 UTC) sam: Running `terraform apply -var-file=prod.pin.tfvars -target=module.peer -auto-approve` in canary now. Will paste summary.

(01:01 UTC) sam: Apply succeeded: 0 add, 1 change, 0 destroy. Hash: 9f4b2c. Canary moved to 25%.

(01:15 UTC) sre-bot: METRIC: Observed 1 BGP flap on tenant-peer-2; no control-plane errors. Monitoring.

(01:25 UTC) sre-bot: METRIC: auth-service 5xx at 5.6% for 6m -> exceeding rollback threshold.

(01:26 UTC) sam: Initiating rollback per criteria. Executing playbook rollback steps.

(01:27 UTC) deploybot: Rollback started by sam -> target tenant-cutover -> tag pre-pin. ETA ~3m.

(01:30 UTC) deploybot: Rollback complete. All changes reverted to pre-pin versions. Workspace unlocked.

(01:32 UTC) rohan: Post-rollback checks look good: routes restored, BGP stable, 5xx back to baseline within 4m.

(01:34 UTC) ivy: We'll postpone the cutover until NAT refactor and extra probe margins are applied. Sam, please keep the hold until you give the all-clear.

sam: Will do. Leaving this thread as canonical. I'll open a follow-up ticket with timeline and lessons.

deploybot: Hold remains. Use `deploybot hold --release --who=sam` to remove.
